explanation: The method measures the bottle, its neck contact band, the source support, and the intended rack support from current RGB-D. It derives a pad-center grasp using the actual tool offset and opening axis, preserves orientation, approaches, closes, and performs an independently observed retention-measurement lift. It then uses bounded object-feedback transfer and lowering, releases, withdraws, and assesses the actual support relation and post-release stability. Tracking is optional: unknown registration triggers reconstruction of the same semantically defined cork-top center, patch reinitialization, or a justified observation-producing move. It never substitutes commanded hand motion for measured object motion. Historical geometry, partial measurements, pending actions, and retention evidence are checkpointed. Unsupported geometry, ambiguous identity, exhausted resources, or unexplained stalls produce an incomplete result without reopening a transferred load. Upright placement requires a measured nearly level usable rack support; an inclined cradle requiring another placement model is reported explicitly rather than guessed.
interface: Executable Python entry point: main(api). The task string is runtime instruction data from this request, not a stored trajectory. Globals used: np, math, geo, and allowed Python builtins. API operations: state, camera, review with structured fields, plane_point, track_init, track_update, control, drive, note, checkpoint, recall. Return: JSON-compatible completion_proposed boolean and evidence, plus a limitation or unresolved-gap statement. Evidence separates actual measurements, historical references, geometric predictions, and visual interpretations. Every named measurement is checked for membership and measurement_errors before use. Plane fits use coefficients; tracker timestamps use frame_id and reference_frame_id. Unknown registration supplies no transform. Checkpoints wine.method.v2 and wine.survey.v2 retain episode-local provenance; repaired execution refreshes the moving object, revalidates static dependencies, and does not reset physical state. Limits include 18 control calls per lease, 40 iterations per route, two observation moves, eight patch initialization attempts, and explicit remaining-budget reserves. A completion proposal is not official evaluator success.
jev_protocol: Every physical action uses api.control directly or through api.drive. Each control request supplies exactly x, y, z, rx, ry, rz, and gripper choice questions. Each axis question explicitly identifies state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation: increase maps to positive, decrease to negative, and within_tolerance to hold. The gripper question reads state.processed_features.objective.gripper and selects exactly open, close, or keep. These unchanged Jev choices map to signed, bounded residual magnitudes computed by the documented controller; Jev performs no metric calculation. Targets refer to pad_center, not TCP. Program features identify the phase and measured object reference; trusted robot state and pose residuals come from the host. Structured observation reviews provide named RGB-D regions, persistent landmark evidence, and explicitly defined enums. Local reviews distinguish observed external obstruction, none observed, unknown, self-occlusion, and unobserved space; none observed is not a clearance certificate. Numerically projected finger bounds include the empty opening, and carried-object envelopes are labelled predictions. A view move requires its own local evidence and a concrete expected observation benefit. Reached means pose/command delivery only; moved remains bounded, unexplained stalled stops, and a lowering stall can proceed only to fresh near-support assessment without further pushing. Retention requires observed bottle displacement consistent with actual hand displacement. Release and completion require fresh object evidence and a separate stability assessment.
